text.en:
To carry out the provisions of this Order, the
Department of Foreign Affairs and Bureau of Immig-
ration are hereby directed to issue implementing
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of
Octobol, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and sixty-nine.
(SGD.) FERDINAND B. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ERNESTO M. MACEDA
Executive Secretary
